title: Databricks tracking auth: databricks://<profile> must pass the profile to the Databricks CLI token call, not authenticate by host
answers: Codex tracing set to databricks://<profile> uses the wrong Databricks CLI account when several profiles point at the same workspace
Where is the Databricks auth provider built from a databricks:// tracking URI?
Why does the SDK Config get the resolved host when a profile is supplied?
body:
Path: Handles tracking URIs of the form databricks://<profile> and related Databricks host, token and config-path settings when the TypeScript SDK builds its auth provider. createDatabricksAuth in libs/typescript/core/src/auth/index.ts resolves host and profile, then constructs the Databricks SDK Config that fetches tokens.
Rule: Construct the SDK Config with the resolved `host` variable (not the raw options.host) together with `profile`. With @databricks/sdk-experimental 0.18.0 the token fetch runs `databricks auth token --profile <profile>` instead of selecting by `--host`, so the chosen profile wins when several CLI profiles target one workspace host.
Symptom: A Codex trace configured with databricks://<profile> could authenticate as a different CLI profile that matched the same workspace host.
Constraints: Covered for databricks-cli auth_type profiles by the 'passes the tracking URI profile to Databricks CLI authentication' test in libs/typescript/core/tests/core/auth.test.ts. Does not change OSS or Kubernetes auth paths.
applies: Profile-based Databricks auth in the TypeScript core package (tracking URI databricks://<profile>).
says: Codex tracing logs to the wrong account when multiple profiles share the same workspace.
Traces record under a different user profile despite choosing a specific workspace profile.
Ensure tracking authentication respects the designated profile rather than matching only by workspace.
Running Codex tracing with a configured profile sends events to an unintended account.
search: For profile-based Databricks auth in the TypeScript core package, createDatabricksAuth in libs/typescript/core/src/auth/index.ts must construct the Databricks SDK Config using the resolved host variable together with profile so token fetching invokes `databricks auth token --profile <profile>` rather than selecting by `--host`. This prevents a Codex trace configured with a databricks://<profile> tracking URI from authenticating as a different CLI profile that targets the same workspace host. The rule applies to databricks-cli auth_type profiles and is tested in libs/typescript/core/tests/core/auth.test.ts, without changing OSS or Kubernetes auth paths.
